confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately grounded (beer uses bottled domestic lager as the draft proxy; service and VAT treatment varies by venue). Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain, and July school-holiday demand could push lodging higher. FX is unverified: the 15 Oct 2026 value (0.6955) came from a search summary of the RBA table, a targeted re-check did not confirm it, and the RBA page in results showed only March 2026 data.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Cali was positioned slightly below Medellin for lodging and nightlife, with restaurant anchors set from typical Colombian mid-size-city menu ranges. Cocktail and wine anchors follow the local beer relationship (cocktail about 3x beer, wine glass about 3.4x beer) because direct Cali bar-price knowledge is weak.
